cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
for i in $(seq 1 6); do grep -q GEMINI_MODEL_CHAIN scripts/generate_ai_analysis.py && break; sleep 10; done
grep -c GEMINI_MODEL_CHAIN scripts/generate_ai_analysis.py; date -u
cat > /tmp/manual_gen2.sh <<'EOS'
#!/bin/bash
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo || exit 1
P=/usr/bin/python3
echo "=== analysis $(date -u +%T)"
timeout 290 $P scripts/generate_ai_analysis.py --force-gemini 2>&1 | iconv -c -f utf-8 -t utf-8 | grep -v 'DeprecationWarning\|now_utc\|utcnow'
echo "=== blocks $(date -u +%T)"
timeout 900 $P scripts/make_blocks_gemini_cloud.py 2>&1 | iconv -c -f utf-8 -t utf-8
echo "=== video $(date -u +%T)"
timeout 1500 $P scripts/make_video.py gemini 2>&1 | iconv -c -f utf-8 -t utf-8 | grep -v 'DeprecationWarning\|now_utc\|utcnow'
echo "video rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
$P - <<'PY'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import vps_ai_pipeline as v
v.git_push_ai()
PY
echo "=== done $(date -u +%T)"
EOS
chmod +x /tmp/manual_gen2.sh
nohup flock /tmp/vps_ai_pipeline.lock bash /tmp/manual_gen2.sh > /tmp/manual_gen2.log 2>&1 &
sleep 20; cut -c1-200 /tmp/manual_gen2.log | head -20
